add_pointrend_config_to_cfg: add PointRend configuration options to a Detectron2 CfgNode for instance segmentation
configure_point_head_params: configure the POINT_HEAD config node with training and inference sampling parameters
enable_implicit_pointrend: enable Implicit PointRend with image features and positional encoding on the config
set_coarse_mask_head: set the ROI mask head input features and output resolution for coarse predictions
customize_point_sampling_ratios: customize the oversample and importance sample ratios for PointRend point sampling
